inherits.description: Parent agent slug or ordered parent slug list composed parent-first before this agent.

system_prompt.description: Prompt fragment that replaces the winning root system-prompt.md; file is trusted catalog content and repo_file is untrusted repository content.

append_system_prompt.description: Prompt fragments appended after root agents.md and before inherited agent bodies.

prompt_template.description: Harness prompt-template source projected only by harnesses that support templates.

skills.description: Skill slugs resolved from agents/<name>/skills first, then catalog-wide skills.

subagents.description: Agent slugs delegated to. Resolved catalog-wide (a delegate is a shared agent, not nested under agents/<name>).

mcp.description: MCP server ids. Per-agent agents/<name>/mcp.json merges by id over layered tree-root mcp.json files before selected servers are projected into the run.

extensions.description: Harness-native extension selections passed through to the launch; no on-disk agent-local namespace.

plugins.description: Harness-native plugin selections passed through to the launch; no on-disk agent-local namespace.

toolName.description: A tool name. A leading '-' would become an independent harness flag when projected, and a comma or whitespace would split the name inside a projected flag value, so all three are rejected.
